title: Use Kimi Code CLI with models on Amazon Bedrock
headline: Use Kimi Code CLI with models on Amazon Bedrock
ai_overview: Kimi Code CLI v2.7.0 adds a native Amazon Bedrock provider, so you can connect the open source coding agent to models like Kimi K3.1 Pro using your standard AWS credential chain (named profiles or SSO) instead of a separate API key. This post shows how to configure the provider and send your first request.
